response.sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, p.product_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_product_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY pc.product_type_description, p.product_id), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM type_stats
